title: Tuned Fitness Landscapes for Benchmarking Model-Guided Protein Design.
authors: Thomas, Neil; Agarwala, Atish; Belanger, David; Song, Yun S; Colwell, Lucy J
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于Potts模型的可调难度合成适应度景观框架SLIP，用于基准测试模型引导的蛋白质设计（MLDE），虽非直接结构预测或采样，但为蛋白质序列-适应度建模和设计方法评估提供了可迁移的计算框架，与蛋白质结构计算课题相关。
abstract: Machine learning-guided directed evolution (MLDE) is an emerging paradigm of protein design where ML models trained on experimental data are used to guide exploration of a protein fitness landscape. Building an MLDE pipeline involves many design choices across the design-build-test-learn loop ranging from data collection strategies to modeling. The cost of collecting experimental data makes benchmarking every component of these pipelines prohibitively difficult, necessitating the development of synthetic landscapes. In this work, we develop a framework called SLIP ("Synthetic Landscape Inference for Proteins") for constructing synthetic landscapes with tunable difficulty based on Potts models. This framework can be extended to any protein family for which there is a sequence alignment. We show that our tuning framework provides landscapes sufficiently challenging to benchmark MLDE pipelines. SLIP is open-source and is available at https://github.com/google-research/slip.
abstract_zh: 机器学习引导的定向进化（MLDE）是蛋白质设计的一种新兴范式，其中基于实验数据训练的机器学习模型被用于指导蛋白质适应度景观的探索。构建MLDE流程涉及在设计-构建-测试-学习循环中的众多设计选择，从数据收集策略到建模不等。实验数据收集的成本使得对这些流程的每个组件进行基准测试变得极其困难，因此有必要开发合成景观。在本工作中，我们开发了一个名为SLIP（“蛋白质合成景观推断”）的框架，用于基于Potts模型构建具有可调难度的合成景观。该框架可扩展到任何具有序列比对的蛋白质家族。我们展示了我们的调优框架能够提供足够具有挑战性的景观，以对MLDE流程进行基准测试。SLIP是开源的，可在https://github.com/google-research/slip获取。
